messages:
maya: idea: add a tiny 'lease' block to rollout metadata so clients can request tenant-scoped soft affinity without global pins. sketch: scope + type + lease{id, expires, audit_ref}.

zoe: smart. two important bits: (1) differentiate soft vs hard pins early, (2) include a non-mutating probe mode so clients can test routing without consuming reservations.

ryan: ops concern: we need GC and reconcile semantics. propose lease_state: active|revoked|expired and a periodic reconcile job that is idempotent. surface metrics for stale leases reclaimed.

maya: sample schema: {"pin": {"scope":"tenant|region|global","type":"soft|hard","lease":{"id":"uuid","issued_by":"control-plane","expires_at":"iso8601","audit_ref":"str"},"client_probe":true,"grace_window_ms":"int"}}

zoe: bikeshed: call it `lease` not `handshake`. add `commit_level` for hard pins: reserved vs best-effort and optional `reserved_units`. also add `max_lease_ms` per-tenant cap.

ryan: compatibility: older runtimes may ignore lease fields. add a capability header `X-Lease-Supported: true|false` on resolve so clients can feature-detect. emit telemetry when fields are ignored during canary.

maya: client flow: 1) resolve with client_probe=true 2) runtime returns candidate routing + probe_confidence + lease_supported header 3) if ok, client requests lease -> control-plane issues lease_id -> runtime honors affinity.

zoe: storage: routing index must stay compact. store small pin_mask + lease_ptr; full lease payload in secondary table.

ryan: audit: every lease assignment needs audit_ref + origin (api|console|migration). enforce per-tenant quotas for hard pins to avoid resource exhaustion.

ops-bot: note queued: rollout-lease-rfc -> staging (sha: ab12cd34) :rocket:

maya: action items: maya will draft RFC with flows and migration checklist; zoe will detail compact index encoding; ryan will write GC/metrics plan. mark fields experimental and auto-expire in 6 months if adoption low.
